text: Understanding databases is essential for modern software. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store data in tables, which organise information into rows and columns. To retrieve data, you write queries using a language like SQL. Good data modeling helps you design tables that reflect real-world relationships and avoid duplication. Indexes make queries faster by helping the database find rows quickly, although they use extra storage. NoSQL databases, on the other hand, are more flexible and suit unstructured data. Choosing the right database depends on your project's needs.
